name: @director-ai/vercel-ai
description: Vercel AI SDK middleware for Director-AI REST review gates

scripts.prebuild: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude=node_modules/** --test-coverage-include=dist/index.js --test-coverage-include=test/*.mjs --test-coverage-include=tools/*.mjs --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 test/*.test.mjs
